# 1 Enoch Chapter 19 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** Then Uriel told me: "This is where the angels who slept with women will be imprisoned. Their spirits have taken on countless disguises, corrupting humanity by luring people into worshiping demons as though they were gods. They will remain here until the final day of judgment, when they will be sentenced and utterly destroyed."

**2** "As for the women who were seduced by these angels — they will become sirens."

**3** I, Enoch, am the only one who has ever seen this vision — the ultimate boundaries of all creation. No other human being has witnessed what I have seen.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering aimed at modern English readability. The chapter is brief but dense with eschatological content. "Sirens" retained as the most recognizable equivalent of the Ge'ez loanword. The punishment theme — demonic deception leading to total judgment — is foregrounded.*
